title: Curvilineal
summary: CURVILINEAR, CURVILINEAL adjective [Latin , bent and a line.] Having a curve line; consisting of curve lines; bounded by curve lines; as a curvilinear figure.

inlines.v: CURVILINEAR, CURVILINEAL adjective [Latin , bent and a line.] Having a curve line; consisting of curve lines; bounded by curve lines; as a curvilinear figure.
